reviews.author: L.D
reviews.text: I ordered the laksa-flavoured ramen, a dish with a distinctive lemongrass aroma that tends to divide opinion. It’s a love-it-or-hate-it flavour: those who enjoy it will keep coming back for more, while those who dislike it are unlikely to order it again. My bowl of noodles was cooked to perfection. Maki & Ramen is located on the lower ground floor of St James Quarter. The restaurant is characterised by its entrance drum, artificial cherry blossoms, and walls covered with cartoon drawings and handwritten notes. Whenever a customer arrives, the staff beat the drum to announce their arrival, letting everyone know that new business has just walked through the door. The cartoon drawings and messages on the walls are entertaining and make the waiting time more enjoyable. We arrived in the evening, and the indoor dining area was already full. Despite how busy the restaurant was, we didn't have to wait long for our food. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and efficient, making the whole dining experience very pleasant.

reviews.author: Ellie Bleasdale
reviews.text: Today was my 5th visit to Maki & Ramen in Leeds, having previously really enjoyed the food and brought along different friends and family on each occasion. My only previous criticism would have been how close together the tables are. Unfortunately, tonight’s experience has completely changed my opinion. The service was extremely disappointing. We waited 15 minutes to be approached, so ended up ordering through the QR code on the table. After receiving our drinks and sharing some sushi, we waited around 35–40 minutes for our ramen. During this time, two tables who arrived after us had already received the exact same dishes. We were never asked if we wanted to order another drink either. When we eventually asked about our order, we were told the ticket hadn’t gone through to the kitchen and asked to show our email receipt. There was no apology, and nobody had checked whether we were enjoying our starter or offered us another drink while we waited. We then waited a further 15 minutes for our food. Having ordered the same ramen on all five visits, I was really disappointed with it. The broth was nowhere near as good as previously, and by this point the long wait and poor service had completely put me off. The only positive was that the karaage chicken was still as good as ever. To finish things off, when we asked to take the remaining food home, we were simply handed two containers to decant the ramen into ourselves. It’s such a shame that a restaurant I’ve previously enjoyed and recommended has left me feeling this way. Unfortunately, I won’t be returning or recommending it going forward. There are plenty of other places in Leeds serving great ramen, and the service tonight has completely put me off coming back. Unfortunately, due to us paying online we had already paid the full amount otherwise we’d have probably asked for the bill & left after the sushi. Then to finish the visit no one asked if we had enjoyed the food , apologised before we left or even said bye thanks for coming as any other restaurant would.

reviews.text: The servers are friendly enough and I can see they aren’t slacking at all, but management is clearly a little disorganised beginning from when you are sat down to the order and timing of the food being brought out. We ordered 2 ramens (tonkostu ramen & steak ramen) and 1 green dragon roll which came to £55. Not much to complain about the sushi it was quite nice, but the ramen is another story. The broth was thick, heavy and oily which is basically the complete opposite of what good ramen is meant to be (light & clean). There was something off with the noodles it seemed to have a weird texture and was chewy. Perhaps it was boiled for too long? Needless to say, we didn’t finish the ramen at all and still spent £55. In the photo attached you can see the layer of oil. Maybe this restaurant is more suited to British tastes, very clearly not targeted for actual Asian palettes.

reviews.author: Shazina Jussab
reviews.text: We visited Maki & Ramen today, really excited to try it as our children love noodles and ramen. Unfortunately, the experience was awful. The food was below mediocre and lacked flavour, just full of soya sauce, while the service was extremely slow and our orders were repeatedly incorrect. My son’s meal arrived after everyone else had finished eating, and we had to separate the children’s meals ourselves. Several items we ordered were only declared out of stock after we had waited several minutes, leaving us to choose alternatives. This was particularly strange given that we visited at 1 pm during half term. We should have been informed upfront rather than left waiting. My daughter’s meal was unbearably salty, and the menu and online ordering system were confusing. We don’t mind paying premium prices for good food, but neither the food nor the service justified the cost. Overall, a terrible experience and certainly won't be going back.

reviews.author: prometheus
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience at Maki & Ramen! I cannot recommend this place enough! From the moment we arrived, the service was exceptional, and the atmosphere was incredibly welcoming. A massive thank you to Imi, Naing and Eryle, who truly made our experience special. All three were incredibly friendly, attentive and professional, going above and beyond to make sure we had a fantastic time. Their positive energy, kindness and genuine hospitality really stood out. The food was absolutely delicious, beautifully presented and full of flavour. Combined with such outstanding customer service, it made the entire experience even better. It’s rare to come across staff who make you feel so genuinely welcome, and Imi, Naing and Eryle are a real credit to Maki & Ramen. They deserve recognition for the incredible work they do! Without a doubt, a five-star experience. We’ll definitely be returning and recommending this place to others!

reviews.text: Waited at least 20 minutes for a server, couple next to us didn’t get their second main until after their first meal. reviews.author: Maria Itiacandy
reviews.text: The drinks were the highlight... The food was fine except for the dessert which I sent back and which was taken off the menu. The chocolate matcha brownie came with vanilla ice cream that was not defrosted or melted properly/ ready to be served to customers. The chocolate sauce/syrup was awful it tasted like the squeezy chocolate sauce you get in the supermarkets. The brownie itself had a strange texture that was neither gooey, dense, OR traditionally cakey for a brownie. The texture was on the tougher side. The flavour tasted like stolen/ christmas cake... Something was clearly wrong here. The server tried to allude to my racial background and say maybe that's why I didn't enjoy the desert... And maybe I'm not used to the matcha taste...which was inappropriate and I corrected her promptly. I like matcha but this dessert was awful. You can (try) see in the picture how pale the brownie looks....

reviews.author: Umer Latif Uqaili
reviews.text: An absolutely fantastic experience! We had a wonderful time at Maki and Ramen. The food was delicious, the atmosphere was lovely, and the overall experience exceeded our expectations. A special mention goes to Yuya A, who served us. Her hospitality, attentiveness, warmth and genuine kindness were truly exceptional. She made us feel so welcome and went above and beyond to ensure we had a memorable experience. It's rare to come across someone who takes such genuine pride in their work and makes customers feel so valued. Highly recommended to anyone looking for fantastic food and exceptional customer service. We will definitely be returning! Thank you, Yuya, and the entire Macchian Ramen team for such a lovely experience! 👏

reviews.author: Martina Spragg
reviews.text: Will not be returning!!!! The time waiting for food was crazy long, other tables sat after us were served, ate and left before we got our food. I sent back my ramen which was not hot, tepid at best. When I finally got a replacement the seafood was so overcooked especially the prawns and salmon which had turned to unchewable rubber but were not even warm. The seafood was horrid. Servers were like deer in headlights that didn't know what to do when I didn't want a third replacement. Would not recommend 😕

reviews.author: Claire “Claire Jones” Jones
reviews.text: Seems an ongoing issue but all noodles and some other bits were out of stock. Unsure why but looking at other reviews it seems this is normal for them. Food was okay, nothing to write home about. Gyozas were nice. Food came before our drinks which was odd.

reviews.author: Shaz R.
reviews.text: I really don’t want this to come across as complaining, as I understand that not everything was within Maki Ramen’s control, especially as I ordered through Slerp. However, the back and forth between Slerp and Maki Ramen while trying to cancel the order was exhausting, particularly after being told I couldn’t cancel. We’ve just moved in and currently don’t have a kitchen or microwave, so waiting over an hour only to receive cold food was really upsetting, especially as I was starving. In the end, we couldn’t even eat the food, which was really disappointing given the circumstances. I appreciated receiving a full refund, and I was also grateful that a goodwill gesture was offered for the inconvenience by Chris the assistant manager, although I haven’t received any further update on this. I’m not trying to be difficult or unappreciative, and I do understand that things can go wrong. I was just really disappointed because, after such a stressful move and currently not having a kitchen or microwave, the experience was much harder than it needed to be. Ultimately, we were left unable to eat our food after waiting over an hour, and although the refund was appreciated, it didn’t change how disappointing the overall experience was.

reviews.author: Massimiliano Vitali
reviews.text: Looking at all the positive reviews, I don't understand whether they are all fake or whether I was just unlucky. We entered the restaurant without a reservation, and the manager didn't seem very happy to welcome us. No one pointed out that there were specials on a board on the wall. We had to ask twice for our drinks because they never arrived, and three times for tap water. No one asked us about allergies when taking our order. The food was well presented but of fairly average quality. Nothing I ordered really stood out. There was no salmon available, and the only dessert was unavailable too. I didn't have a great experience.
